# Commodity Hub

> Live prices, forward curves, CFTC positioning, and seasonality data for commodity futures — oil, metals, grains, and more, sourced from CME, CBOT, COMEX, and NYMEX. Free tier available; Premium and Pro add deeper analytics.

Commodity Hub is a data and analytics product, not a broker — it does not execute trades or hold funds. Prices and positioning data below are updated on the cadence noted for each section; always check the "updated" timestamp on a page before citing a specific number as current.

## Live data

- [Live Positioning](https://commodity-hub.eu/now): current CFTC Commitment of Traders managed-money positioning per commodity, updated weekly (Fridays, CFTC's own publication schedule)
- [Commodities](https://commodity-hub.eu/commodities): live price, exchange, ticker, and contract specs per commodity

## Data API

- [Data API](https://commodity-hub.eu/api): REST API — current and historical commodity prices, CFTC COT positioning, EIA/USDA/FRED fundamentals, news, community sentiment, your own portfolio/watchlist/alert data, and curve analytics (volatility cone, roll yield scanner, forward term structure). JSON responses, per-key auth (`Authorization: Bearer ch_live_...`). Free tier: 1 key, 50 requests/day, no card required, covers most resources. Pro ($19.99/mo): unlimited keys, 60 requests/minute per key, no monthly cap, adds the curve-analytics resources; the news resource separately needs a Premium or Pro app subscription. No per-request/usage-based billing at any tier. Full documentation — auth, all 11 resources, parameters, rate limits, error codes and pricing — is at [commodity-hub.eu/api](https://commodity-hub.eu/api); the in-app [developer reference](https://app.commodity-hub.eu/developers) adds field-level schemas and the OpenAPI description.

## Reference

- [Glossary](https://commodity-hub.eu/glossary): short, precise definitions of futures-market concepts — contango/backwardation, COT report, crack spread, seasonality
- [Learn](https://commodity-hub.eu/learn): longer guides on reading curves, positioning, and seasonal patterns
- [Market Data Calendar](https://commodity-hub.eu/calendar): when the recurring reports that move commodity prices (COT, EIA petroleum, EIA natural gas storage, WASDE, OPEC+) are actually released

## Tools

- [Roll Yield Calculator](https://commodity-hub.eu/tools/roll-yield-calculator): computes the roll cost or benefit of holding a futures position through contango or backwardation, from two user-entered prices
- [Embeddable Price Widget](https://commodity-hub.eu/embed): free live price widget publishers can embed on their own sites
